title: Claim-Free Standing and What the Host Carries of a Loss
content:
An enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan that has gone a long time without a claim, and owes nothing on its own account, carries less of an accepted loss.

- Where the plan publishes a waiver period, the enrolment has gone at least that long without a claim being accepted on it and nothing stands unpaid on the enrolment, the share is waived altogether.
- Where the enrolment has gone at least the plan's qualifying period without a claim being accepted on it but less than the waiver period the plan publishes, and nothing stands unpaid on the enrolment, one less the plan's claim-free discount is applied to the share.
- In every other case the share is carried at the whole of the figure it was measured at.

### The periods and the discount each plan publishes

| Plan | Qualifying period, claim-free months | Waiver period, claim-free months | Claim-free discount, percent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 24 | 0 | 10 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 24 | 0 | 12 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 18 | 0 | 15 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 18 | 36 | 18 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 12 | 24 | 20 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 12 | 12 | 25 |

A waiver period published as 0 months is no waiver period at all, so on the Keyturn Shield 90, Keyturn Shield 85 and Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plans the first reading never arises and an enrolment past the qualifying period carries the discount instead.

### Worked readings (hypothetical figures, on a share measured at 2000)

| Plan | Claim-free months | Unpaid on the enrolment | Share carried at |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 20 | none | 1700.00, the discount of 15 percent applied |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 20 | some | 2000.00 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 26 | none | nothing, the share waived |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 14 | none | 1600.00, the discount of 20 percent applied |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 10 | none | 2000.00 |

The months are counted in whole calendar months from the claim-free day standing on the enrolment, and anything at all standing unpaid on the enrolment puts the reading into the last case.
